caption: The drawing features a repeating pattern on a muted teal background. Within the pattern, there are several distinct elements: a man dressed in historical attire holding a rifle, accompanied by a small dog; a decorative structure resembling a gazebo or a small pavilion with a pointed roof; and gardens with flowers and tall, slender trees. The flowers are rendered in shades of teal, white, black, and dark green, with branches and leaves interspersed throughout the pattern. The man, dog, garden structure, and trees are depicted in similar shades of teal, white, black, and green, blending harmoniously with the background and floral elements. The architectural features, such as a white picket fence and a section of a roof, are clearly defined and bordered by the trees and flowers. The artist's name "S. Liswood" is printed at the bottom right corner of the image. The overall composition is orderly and symmetrical, with each motif spaced evenly and repeating in a structured arrangement.
title: Wall Paper
